source_refs.note: Exercise 12.2, Question 1 (i)-(iii): left and right hand limits and the limit as x -> c (book p.233). Answer key PDF 310 agrees.

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Determine the left hand limit and the right hand limit and then, find limit of the following functions when \(x \to c\). \(f(x) = 2x^2 + x - 5,\ c = 1\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh one-sided limits (ek taraf ki limit) ka sawal hai, aur function ek polynomial hai.
Humein teen cheezein find karni hain: left hand limit (LHL), right hand limit (RHL), aur phir asal limit at \(x = 1\).
Polynomial ki khoobi yeh hai ke is ka graph kahin nahi toot'ta, aur dono taraf ek hi formula chalta hai.
Plan: dono taraf \(x = 1\) seedha put karenge, phir dono jawab compare karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2x^2 + x - 5\), \(c = 1\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x)\), \(\lim_{x \to 1^+} f(x)\) aur \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\).
Tareeqa: Polynomial ki limit direct substitution (seedha value rakhna) se nikalti hai, yeh humne theorems on limits mein parha tha. Limit sirf tab exist karti hai jab LHL aur RHL barabar hon.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^-} (2x^2 + x - 5)\]
\[= 2(1)^2 + 1 - 5\]
\[= 2 + 1 - 5 = -2\]
Kyun: \(x \to 1^-\) ka matlab hai ke \(x\) chhoti values se 1 ki taraf aa raha hai, jaise 0.9, 0.99, 0.999. Wahan bhi yahi formula lagta hai. Polynomial mein koi jump ya hole nahi hota, is liye \(x = 1\) seedha rakh dena jaiz hai.
Dhyan dein: \(2(1)^2\) mein pehle square karein phir 2 se multiply; \(2(1)^2 = 2\), \(4\) nahi.

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 1^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^+} (2x^2 + x - 5)\]
\[= 2(1)^2 + 1 - 5 = -2\]
Kyun: Right side se (1.1, 1.01, 1.001) aate hue bhi formula wahi hai, is liye jawab bhi wahi \(-2\) aaya. Jab dono taraf ek hi formula ho to LHL aur RHL hamesha barabar aate hain.

Dono ko compare kar ke limit likhein
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = -2\]
\[\lim_{x \to 1} f(x) = -2\]
Kyun: Limit ka criterion yeh hai: agar left aur right dono limits exist karen aur barabar hon, to limit exist karti hai aur usi value ke barabar hoti hai. Yahan dono \(-2\) hain.

Tasdeeq
\[f(0.99) = 1.9602 + 0.99 - 5 = -2.0498\]
\[f(1.01) = 2.0402 + 1.01 - 5 = -1.9498\]
Kyun: 1 se zara pehle aur zara baad ki values dono \(-2\) ke qareeb hain. Is tarah calculator se check karna exam mein confidence deta hai ke jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Determine the left hand limit and the right hand limit and then, find limit of the following functions when \(x \to c\). \(f(x) = \frac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3},\ c = -3\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi one-sided limits ka sawal hai, lekin function ab ek fraction (rational function) hai.
Humein \(x = -3\) par LHL, RHL aur limit find karni hai.
Ghaur karein: denominator \(x - 3\) sirf \(x = 3\) par zero hota hai, \(x = -3\) par nahi. To yahan masla nahi, phir bhi fraction ko simplify kar lena kaam aasaan kar deta hai.
Plan: factorise kar ke cancel karein, phir dono taraf \(x = -3\) rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}\), \(c = -3\).
Humein find karna hai: LHL, RHL aur \(\lim_{x \to -3} f(x)\).
Tareeqa: \(x^2 - 9\) ko factorise karenge aur \(x - 3\) cancel karenge. Cancel karna is liye jaiz hai ke \(-3\) ke aas paas \(x \ne 3\), yani \(x - 3\) zero nahi. Simplify hone ke baad polynomial bach jata hai, jis mein seedha value rakh sakte hain.

Function ko simplify karein
\[x^2 - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3)\]
\[f(x) = \frac{(x - 3)(x + 3)}{x - 3}\]
\[= x + 3 \quad (x \ne 3)\]
Kyun: Yeh difference of squares (do squares ka farq) ka formula hai: \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\), jahan \(a = x\), \(b = 3\). \(-3\) ke qareeb \(x - 3\) taqreeban \(-6\) hai, zero nahi, is liye upar neeche se cancel karna bilkul theek hai.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to -3^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to -3^-} (x + 3)\]
\[= -3 + 3 = 0\]
Kyun: \(-3\) se zara chhoti values (jaise \(-3.01\), \(-3.001\)) par simplified formula \(x + 3\) hi lagta hai. Is mein \(x = -3\) rakha to 0 aaya.
Dhyan dein: \(-3\) se "left" ka matlab hai number line par aur negative, yani \(-3.01\), na ke \(-2.99\).

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to -3^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to -3^+} (x + 3)\]
\[= -3 + 3 = 0\]
Kyun: \(-3\) se zara bari values (jaise \(-2.99\)) par bhi wahi formula hai, is liye jawab wahi 0.

Compare kar ke limit likhein
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = 0\]
\[\lim_{x \to -3} f(x) = 0\]
Kyun: Dono taraf ki limits barabar hain, is liye criterion ke mutabiq limit exist karti hai aur 0 hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-3) = \frac{9 - 9}{-3 - 3} = \frac{0}{-6} = 0\]
Kyun: Yahan function \(x = -3\) par defined bhi hai aur us ki value 0 limit ke barabar hai, is liye jawab pakka hai. Fraction sirf \(x = 3\) par undefined hai, jo hamara point nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{0}{-6} = 0\) bilkul theek hai; masla sirf tab hota hai jab denominator zero ho.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Determine the left hand limit and the right hand limit and then, find limit of the following functions when \(x \to c\). \(f(x) = |x - 5|,\ c = 5\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein absolute value (modulus, yani hamesha positive wali value) aa gayi hai.
Humein \(x = 5\) par LHL, RHL aur limit find karni hai.
Modulus ka formula 5 par badal jata hai, kyunke 5 se pehle \(x - 5\) negative hai aur 5 ke baad positive.
Plan: dono taraf ka alag formula likhenge (modulus hata kar), phir har taraf value rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = |x - 5|\), \(c = 5\).
Humein find karna hai: LHL, RHL aur \(\lim_{x \to 5} f(x)\).
Tareeqa: Modulus ki definition: agar \(a \ge 0\) to \(|a| = a\), aur agar \(a < 0\) to \(|a| = -a\). Kyunke \(x - 5\) ka sign 5 par badalta hai, is liye left aur right ke liye alag formula banega.

Modulus hata kar \(f\) likhein
\[f(x) = \begin{cases} 5 - x, & x < 5 \\ x - 5, & x \ge 5 \end{cases}\]
Kyun: Misaal ke taur par \(x = 4\) lein: \(x - 5 = -1\), aur \(|-1| = 1 = 5 - 4\). Yani 5 se pehle \(|x - 5| = -(x - 5) = 5 - x\). Aur \(x = 6\) par \(x - 5 = 1\), modulus kuch nahi badalta. Yeh minus sign hi negative ko positive banata hai.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 5^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 5^-} (5 - x)\]
\[= 5 - 5 = 0\]
Kyun: 5 se zara pehle (4.9, 4.99) formula \(5 - x\) hai, is mein 5 rakha to 0.

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 5^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 5^+} (x - 5)\]
\[= 5 - 5 = 0\]
Kyun: 5 ke baad (5.1, 5.01) formula \(x - 5\) hai, is mein bhi 5 rakhne se 0 aata hai.

Compare kar ke limit likhein
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = 0\]
\[\lim_{x \to 5} f(x) = 0\]
Kyun: Dono limits barabar hain, is liye limit exist karti hai.
Dhyan dein: Kai students sochte hain ke modulus wale function ki limit "exist nahi karti". Aisa nahi; yahan graph V shape ka hai, us ka kona \((5, 0)\) par hai, lekin graph toot'ta nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[f(4.99) = |{-0.01}| = 0.01\]
\[f(5.01) = |0.01| = 0.01\]
Kyun: Dono taraf values 0 ke bilkul qareeb hain, jaisa limit ne bataya. Kona (corner) hona aur toot jana (break) do alag cheezein hain.
